title: GRAFT — Graph of Relatedness, Applications, Families and Taxonomy
description: A Neo4j knowledge graph linking the Open Tree of Life synthetic taxonomy (4.5M taxa) to multilingual common names (NCBI, GBIF) and a Google Patents BigQuery patent layer (759,182 patents across 22,876 species), with all IPC/CPC class definitions resolved. Includes the full ingest and analysis pipeline, topological and time-calibrated (TimeTree of Life v5) Mantel tests of phylogenetic signal in patent applications, an interactive FastAPI/D3 web interface, and the manuscript. Public companion to the paper 'GRAFT: phylogenetic signal in patent applications across the tree of life.'
